description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter is about to be discontinued.

description.zh: 数据同步实例所在地域的id，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The ID of the region where the data synchronization instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh:
同步方向，取值：
- **Forward**：正向。
- **Reverse**：反向。

> - 默认取值为**Forward**。
> - 当数据同步实例的拓扑类型为双向时，才可以传入**Reverse**以启动反向同步链路。
description.en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
- **Forward**: forward.
- **Reverse**: reverse.

> - Default value: **Forward**.
> - You can set this parameter to **Reverse** to start the reverse synchronization link only if the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

description.zh: 数据同步实例ID，可以通过调用**DescribeSynchronizationJobs**接口查询。
description.en: The ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the **DescribeSynchronizationJobs** operation to query the instance ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts start-synchronization-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --synchronization-job-id dtsf19100l21860000 --synchronization-direction Forward --account-id 16897260618290000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts StartSynchronizationJob --region cn-hangzhou --SynchronizationJobId dtsf19100l21860000 --AccountId 16897260618290000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SynchronizationDirection Forward
